_doc: Beast fit (beast_fit.py) for the mire maw from master maw-open-gape-s7202 (sha256 12a569aa...e6a4), TRELLIS.2 seed 7, finish.mjs --mode bake --rot -50 --palette MireMawOpenGape. Metres in the finish.py character frame at the finished height 1.249 m, measured 2026-10-24 from a front depth probe, a section at x 0.08 through the gape and 5 cm leg columns (docs/research/CREATURE-MESH-2026-10-24.md). The gape, teeth, eyes and a tongue lump are in the TRELLIS mesh, so nothing is cut and no eyes are added; the one part is a capsule tongue lying on the mouth floor for the Attack lash (the rig stretches only Tongue-material faces). Each foot bone runs along its side from the front paw to the back paw, so both paws stay planted (the 11-bone skeleton has one foot per side).
